SUPPORTS.description: Source or knowledge provides evidence for a task, decision, rule or artifact.

DERIVED_FROM.description: A derived node was created from one or more identified upstream nodes.

GOVERNS.description: An approved rule or decision constrains a downstream task, protocol or output.

CONSUMED_BY.description: A task or protocol is authorized to retrieve and consume a knowledge node.

PRODUCES.description: A task or protocol produces an artifact, output or QC evidence node.

EVALUATES.description: QC evidence or a QC task evaluates an artifact or output.

REVISES.description: A decision or output is an authorized revision of a prior artifact or output.

SUPERSEDES.description: An approved node replaces an older node while preserving history.

PROMOTED_FROM.description: An approved project or system rule was promoted from a lower-scope knowledge node.

CONFLICTS_WITH.description: Two nodes contain an unresolved or intentionally preserved conflict.

invariants: Edges never change the information state of either endpoint.
DERIVED_FROM does not convert DERIVED information into SOURCE.
PROMOTED_FROM requires explicit approval and preserves the original node.
SUPERSEDES preserves history and never deletes the superseded endpoint.
Cross-project edges require explicit scope and cannot expose confidential project knowledge.
